title: Halden Analytics: protecting billing data accuracy

slides.headline: Monitoring runs inside your cloud account

bullets.text: The agent runs in your own cloud account. [E4]

slides.speaker_notes: Answer the security question before anything else. Objection O1: the agent is deployed in the customer's account.

slides.headline: Monitors catch what tests were not written for

bullets.text: Drift, staleness and volume checks on every table. [E1]
Veridian Checks tests tables one by one in code. [E8]
Both can run side by side. [E8]

slides.speaker_notes: Objection O2: position Halden beside the existing tests, not against them.

slides.headline: Faster triage protects billing accuracy

bullets.text: Alerts reach the owning team within five minutes. [E1]
A regional water company cut triage from six hours to ninety minutes. [E2]
Brightwater plans a billing accuracy program for 2027. [E7]

slides.speaker_notes: Tie detection speed to the CIO's billing accuracy goal.
